replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Most of the time we do not need more to verify something so blatant, it's the quality of the video over the quantity of videos, hence even one or two videos cane easily suffice. More to the point, I have to ask, why are you going out of your way to act sketchy? 
If you're supposedly purposely acting "sketchy" then you're pretty much asking for some sort of punishment. Once again, it is very evident that you are not lagging in the first video, once again because you were shot and took near instant kb, rather then receiving kb delay as someone with lag would normally.

Forward to Stimpy_Jr

replies.body:
I will repeat this once more and only once more.

You were clearly shown to NOT be lagging in my video (In first person), you were not shown to be lagging as you took little to no delay in receiving the knockback dealt to you by an arrow shot, meaning you weren't lagging because you took no kb delay in the first video (my video in first person) 

In addition, you are not the only Australian on Avicus, there are quite a few, most of them don't receive anywhere near as much lag to appear to hit people without looking at them as seen in the second video. (replay mod) Lag is no explanation for the fact that you hit people without even looking at them, at :40 you are very clearly seen to not only be hitting someone from far away without looking at them, but hitting two people at once, how do you explain this with lag? Also, why would you "pretend" to be sketchy just to be reported?
